D1-M13: Mouseion Contingent led 17-11 after two rounds by spreading over all three objectives: the Hephaestian Tripod held the east unopposed (10.8 VP for 20 RP), and League Hoplite 1 survived every round it was named for FORLORN HOPE. The Protectores won the fighting from Round 3 (160 RP destroyed for 20, Heron of Alexandria killed for ASSASSINATION) and scored the 10 VP maximum in Round 4, but finished 4 short.
D1-M14: The Veiled Court took Uruk's Temple Levy away: Whispers of Forbidden Pleasure seized Temple Levy 2 and then 3 for a round each, and Temptation of Earthly Delight turned Temple Levy 1 for good in Round 3. From Round 3 the Court held all three objectives and scored the 10 VP maximum three rounds running; Uruk scored only FORLORN HOPE after Round 2.
D1-M15: The Chonae Wing's six Covenant Levies squads out-held the Cossacks' fast cavalry, taking all three objectives in Round 2 and scoring 10 VP in Rounds 2 and 4. The Bulava lost RAISE THE STANDARD in Round 1, when Michaelite Brethren 2 walked onto the standard, and scored only in Round 3. Terek Shashka Riders 1 did the most damage on the table (38).
D1-M16: The Golden Tumen scored the 10 VP maximum in each of three rounds, the fastest win the cap allows: its Tamga-Bound Troops out-numbered the dead on every objective, the Round 3 ones by just 1 and 2 OC. The March lost its one hard squad, the Akhguard, attacking Genghis Khan in Round 2, and never scored BLEED THEM WHITE.
D1-M17: The Glandore Breakers' Sidhe took all three objectives in the first move and led 17-2 after two rounds. The Winter Host won Rounds 4 and 5, 13-4 - ASSASSINATION on Morrigan's Chosen, and Rurik with the Rynda Guard holding the west - but never held more than one objective, and the Breakers closed it with the 10 VP maximum in Round 6.
D1-M18: The Murderhost's eight-unit charge in Round 2 broke all three Ashigaru squads off their ground; it held the centre every round and the east in five of six, with Cultist Zealots 1 (10 RP) doing 31 damage, 4 kills and ASSASSINATION. Kishomon stayed in touch through an Armored Gashadokuro that held the west from Round 2 without ever acting (17.5 VP) and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION (9 VP).
